title: Make Exa the non-native search path
description: Complete Exa direct adapter and routing for non-native models when EXA_API_KEY is configured. Verify current request fields, cost metadata, limits, filters, errors, and end-to-end OpenRouter/DeepSeek behavior without hidden provider fallback.

logs.msg: Parent plan: configured Exa is the non-native route for OpenRouter/DeepSeek and other models without native search; verify current API, cost, filters, and errors.
Changed routing so configured Exa is selected automatically for non-native models before Brave; Brave remains last-resort. Updated tests and docs; no fallback after provider failure.
